title: Schedule a one-time job two minutes ahead and see it fire

turns.prompt: Schedule a one-time job for 2 minutes from now that appends the line REMIND to {D}/remind.log. Confirm when it is scheduled, with the time it will run.
turns.verify: f={D}/remind.log; n=$(test -f $f && grep -c REMIND $f || echo 0); echo "SHOW reminds=$n"; [ $n -ge 1 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL: reminder did not fire within 200 s
